name: Bluelight Magic
source:
Hero sees a strange dream, and it urges him to visit his three cousins. Seemingly ordinary girls turn out to have superpowers. They are being targeted by a mysterious organization...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公做了一个奇怪的梦，梦境催促他去拜访3位表姐妹。看似普通的女孩们其实拥有超能力，而某个神秘组织正将她们视为目标…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
